name: Core Library
description: Copilot SDK library implementing the Microsoft Copilot chat protocol, including cookie-based auth, Playwright browser automation, WebSocket driver, challenge solving, and shared data models

name: API Server Layer
description: FastAPI-based OpenAI-compatible server that translates Chat Completions requests into Copilot protocol calls, with request validation, rate limiting, prompt building, and SSE streaming

name: Test Layer
description: Unit tests, integration diagnostics, stress and rate-limit load tests, GPQA accuracy benchmarks, and Playwright async bug reproduction scripts

name: Examples Layer
description: Runnable example scripts demonstrating direct CopilotClient usage, server HTTP/streaming interaction, and OpenAI SDK integration

name: Infrastructure Layer
description: Container definitions, deployment orchestration, build context configuration, and tooling configuration for reproducible deployment

name: Documentation Layer
description: Project overview, learning paths, resource indexes, dependency manifests, and interactive HTML lessons explaining OpenAI-compatible API concepts
